newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Some truck offers fall further.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Some truck offers fall further.

text.p: Some truck soymeal basis offers fell further Wednesday as prices stayed under pressure from weakening export and domestic demand, dealers said.
"Meal basis is continuing to slip and the processors are cutting back," said one Indiana-based dealer.
However, river basis offers got some support from ideas that a strike at Paranagua Port in Brazil could divert some export business to the U.S., dealers said.
There are also rumors that China buyers were re-selling up to 300,000 tonnes of soymeal on the world market, cash dealers and exporters said.
No confirmation of the sales could be obtained, however.
The flooding of the Ohio River has stalled most rail movement of soymeal in Kentucky and slowed shipments to the southeast, dealers said.
More rain was expected Wednesday and the high water situation wasn't expected to improve for a week to ten days, river dealers said.
